findings.claim: The produced clip does not meet the authored ground-contact acceptance; it is a partial proxy animation, not an accepted gait.
findings.evidence: The incoming worktree walk_cycle.json reports minimum hind-foot gaps of 0.64849 m (left) and 0.64639 m (right) against 0.02 m tolerances, zero of 9 nominal-stance samples in tolerance for each target, and sampled horizontal displacement of 0.10378 m / 0.07900 m. Its validation.passed is false and rig result contains the geometric-contact warning. This is correctly visible as failure; the GLB export itself remains a partial artifact.

findings.claim: The typed GLB animation check accepts structurally invalid channels because it treats validate_structure().validated as an error-free result.
findings.evidence: commands/rig_creature.py:29-33 checks structural.validated and nonzero channel count but ignores structural.errors/issues. optimize/glb.py:765 returns validated=true even when its errors count is nonzero. The synthetic malformed-target probe reports passed=true while structural_errors=1 and animation_target_missing for node 999.
findings.reproducer: Run python var/luna-gait-review-four/probe.py with PYTHONPATH set to stalthos-toolkit/src.

findings.claim: Authored contact selectors are not used to construct the checks, and differing target tolerances collapse to the most permissive maximum.
findings.evidence: blender/scripts/rig.py:229-235 reads the contact but computes one max tolerance and hard-codes both selector aliases; later loops at :243 and :290 use that fixed map. The current smalltrotter YAML happens to define exactly those two selectors at the same 0.02 m tolerance, so this run matches its input. Removing, renaming, adding or tightening one target would still produce checks for the hard-coded two selectors and/or weaken the stricter target threshold.

findings.claim: The sampled stance displacement metric is anchored to the first stored stance point rather than the touchdown point, so it is not a maximum slip-from-contact measurement.
findings.evidence: rig.py:294-295 samples at six Hz; :314-317 appends only stance positions; :343-350 measures every appended point from positions[0]. For rear_R the cyclic stance spans phase 0.5 through 1.0 and wraps to 0.0-0.12. Since the positions are collected in ascending phase order, positions[0] is phase 0.0 (late stance), not the phase 0.5 touchdown. The reported 0.07900 m is therefore a sampled displacement relative to that late-stance anchor and may miss the maximum excursion from contact. The metadata also discloses omitted actor stride translation and says this proxy does not prove horizontal foot lock.
findings.reproducer: Run python var/luna-gait-review-four/probe.py with PYTHONPATH set to stalthos-toolkit/src; compare rear_right_sampled_stance_phases with rig.py:294-350.

unproven_claims: Neutral-only compatibility is supported by the conditional source path (gait outputs are added only when a walk_cycle contact exists), but this review did not rerun the Blender-backed neutral-only export.
The produced GLB has a real animation and matching sampled channel endpoints, but native Wicked actor playback was not demonstrated by this source/GLB review.
validation_debt: The GLB validator needs a negative case with an existing animation containing an invalid target or other structural issue; the current test only covers a GLB with no animation at all.
Contact validation needs per-selector mapping and tolerances, with missing/unknown selectors represented as typed validation failures rather than implicit proxy checks.
Foot-slip aggregation should anchor to touchdown and report sampled per-stance excursion; it currently measures displacement from the first qualifying point in ascending phase order.

effort.attempted: Read the handoff before implementation rationale, inspected the requested diff and existing definition, ran four Blender-free gait tests, parsed the actual exported GLB and checked structural errors/varying channels/endpoints, passed a malformed missing-node channel through the typed validator, checked cyclic rear-right stance-phase wrapping and slip-anchor semantics, and inspected the actual measured contact report. The combined test_gait plus test_blender run was interrupted in a slow timeout test to avoid duplicating the parent's already-running full suite; it is not counted as complete.
